## cilium-dbg status

Display status of daemon

```

```

### Options

```
      --all-addresses[=true|false]              Show all allocated addresses, not just count
      --all-clusters[=true|false]               Show all clusters
      --all-controllers[=true|false]            Show all controllers, not just failing
      --all-health[=true|false]                 Show all health status, not just failing
      --all-nodes[=true|false]                  Show all nodes, not just localhost
      --all-redirects[=true|false]              Show all redirects
      --brief[=true|false]                      Only print a one-line status message
  -h, --help[=true|false]                       help for status
  -o, --output string                           json| yaml| jsonpath='{}'
      --require-k8s-connectivity[=true|false]   If true, when the cilium-agent cannot access the Kubernetes control plane, this status command returns a non-zero exit status. (default true)
      --timeout duration                        Sets the timeout to use when querying for health (default 30s)
      --verbose[=true|false]                    Equivalent to --all-addresses --all-controllers --all-nodes --all-redirects --all-clusters --all-health
```
